# function: format

Fills the scheme's template with its static values plus the variable parts in `variables`, checking each component against the scheme's constraints. Define the scheme once with `scheme` and pass it to every call.

If the scheme has resource type rules, the rules for the value of its `by` component (for example `type`) are applied in this order:

1. `lowercase`: lowercase every part of the name.
2. `remove`: delete every character matching a regular expression, template text included.
3. `fit`: give one component the room left under `max_length`. The room is calculated from the declared maximum lengths of the other components, so it is the same in every environment.
4. `min_length`, `max_length`: check the length of the finished name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  naming = provider::naming::scheme(
    "{org}-{env}-{region}-{type}-{name}",
    {
      org    = "acme"
      env    = "prod"
      region = "weu"
    },
  )
}

# acme-prod-weu-rg-network
output "resource_group_name" {
  value = provider::naming::format(local.naming, {
    type = "rg"
    name = "network"
  })
}

# Constraints and per-resource-type rules are part of the scheme.
# See the `scheme` function for a complete Key Vault and storage account example.
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
format(config object, variables map of string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `config` (Object) A scheme, as returned by `scheme`, including any resource type rules.
1. `variables` (Map of String) Values for the placeholders not set in the scheme's `static`.
